# Now 2.10.77
- The two-finger track-change swipe now only starts on the album artwork. Swiping over the title or artist text no longer moves the artwork or skips tracks. - Gesture ownership is locked at the start of each swipe, so a swipe that begins on the text is ignored for its whole duration and can't hijack the artwork mid-gesture. - The scoped region follows the actual rendered artwork, so it stays correct across every layout preset, widget size, and overlay placement.

# Now 2.10.76
- Fixed Apple Music synchronized lyrics sometimes remaining unavailable even though Music had already loaded them. - Native Apple Music lyrics now interrupt a slower online fallback as soon as Music writes the matching TTML response to its cache. - Added a subtle, stable 120 ms lyric presentation hold so timestamp-corrected lines no longer feel slightly ahead of the audible vocal. - Preserved the precise 30 Hz playback clock and source-timestamp compensation; the old variable polling lag has not been restored.

# Now 2.10.75
- Fixed synchronized lyric lines appearing slightly after the matching audio in Apple Music and YouTube Music. - Playback positions now retain the source timestamp and compensate for MediaRemote, browser, extension, AppleScript, and refresh-debounce transport time. - Apple Music’s MediaRemote stream now uses microsecond elapsed and timestamp values instead of anchoring stale raw positions at receipt time. - Increased live lyric evaluation from 10 Hz to 30 Hz, reducing the view’s worst-case line handoff delay from 100 ms to about 33 ms. - Existing YouTube Music extension installations remain compatible by using their snapshot capture timestamp automatically; no manual extension reload is required.
